text: and make sure you setup for undo history properly. but yes, its all fair game to run on. hit it with /marathon skill
resolution: Brought the corrected painter into the live Studio, full scope, undoable. WHAT: (W1) paint is now BRANCH data — StoredPart.paint (surface-cell→slot id) + StoredModel.palette, with new modelStream events partPaintUpdated/modelPaletteSet routed through studioModel.commit() so strokes + recolours are persisted AND undoable (editPaint/setPalette, one stroke = one undo entry on mouse-up); this fixes the called-out gap that paint lived in twig useHotState (never saved, never undoable). (W2) meshPaint re-keyed from atlas texels to UNIFORM model-surface cells (faceCellGrid derives cell size from each face's own world↔uv scale) — kills slivers; pickFaceCell/brushCells clamp per-face (no spill). (W3) TextureAtlas bakes each cell as a seamless atlas rect (cellAtlasRect shared-edge rounding) — kills pinstripes. (W4) you paint a SLOT (pseudo-colour) resolved through the palette to a colour set; recolour the same paint by cycling the variant; pseudo/painted view toggle; toolbar = slot chips + variant + view + eraser + brush. (W5) material slots bake the catalog material (FILL_FUNCS split out of fillShader, FILL_SHADER behaviour unchanged) sampled in continuous surface-uv at worldPerTile, masked to the slot's cells (MaterialFill) — no per-cell repeat, world-scaled. Split meshPaintOverlay out so the math is import-clean. VERIFIED: hmsc-int builds clean; the /studio route boots without crash; meshPaint pure-math tests 8/8 (uniform grid, SEAMLESS tiling = no-pinstripe invariant, per-face clamp); added a modelStream paint+palette cold-reopen + inverse test. NOT yet verified headlessly (needs rjit dev): live interactive painting and the MaterialFill Effect-in-StaticSurface bake (the flagged risk — colour slots work via Box fills regardless). Files: modelStream.ts, studioModel.ts, meshPaint.tsx, meshPaintOverlay.tsx, TextureAtlas.tsx, MaterialFill.tsx, Studio.tsx, render3d/fillShader.ts + 2 tests.
